content.text:
Pickiness around greens is really common at 28 months. Toddlers are wary of new, bitter-tasting foods. Try putting a tiny portion of a green next to something he already likes, and eat it yourself without comment or pushing. It can take 10 or more calm exposures before it gets tried, so a "no thanks" still counts as progress.

Also, I couldn't sign kids up for programs before. Starting Dec 1, I can do that with your ok.
